entities.name: Vis Svokunol
entities.description: Loxodon veteran and former mercenary who was Asterion's childhood caretaker and was wrongfully executed.

entities.name: Asterion
entities.description: Human noble raised partly by Vis who later sought the lost city of Zantafar.

entities.name: Lord Teutamos
entities.description: Asterion's father who pronounced Vis's sentence.

entities.name: Zantafar
entities.description: Lost city Asterion sought in Vis's name.

entities.name: The Butcher
entities.description: Notorious mercenary name by which Vis was identified.

events.summary: A traveling merchant identifies Vis as The Butcher and he is arrested.
events.quote: a traveling merchant identified him as

events.summary: Vis dies in a stockade after Lord Teutamos pronounces the sentence.
events.quote: left in a stockade without food or water for three days until he succumbed to his suffering

relations.note: Father of Asterion who sentenced Vis to death.
relations.quote: Asterion’s father, Lord Teutamos, bound by the rigid laws of their society, pronounced the sentence
